1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is a machine-readable tag that is not visible to the naked eye and requires specialized equipment to read.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and is protected from external contamination by the test tube material.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and wherein the embedding material comprises a protective layer that prevents direct contact between the MTP and external surfaces.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube designed for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer such that the MTP remains readable after exposure to temperatures of -20°C or lower.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack specifically designed for biorepository test tubes with integrated temperature control; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes with RFID reading capability; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes while maintaining sample integrity and tracking via the embedded MTP.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less while maintaining the readability of the embedded MTP throughout the storage period.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP such that the MTP becomes permanently embedded within the plastic material.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded MTP; positioning the test tube assembly in a reader device; and reading the MTP using specialized equipment that detects the machine-readable tag through the test tube material.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is capable of withstanding repeated freeze-thaw cycles without degradation.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and wherein the embedding material comprises a protective layer.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and wherein the embedding material provides protection from external contamination.
